zh-Hans: 本轮重点：空间中的原理图／PCB、LaTeX、生物学与 CAD 工程分析工作台；PCB 画布编辑、检查、原理图更新及差异预览；LaTeX 源码折叠、PDF 搜索与全屏布局；音乐编辑及预制音色；科学计算、CSV 与正文内图表等内容；iPhone 导航、任务中心和文件批量管理；连接历史与蓝牙串口发现；Linux 软件源、依赖安装与已有环境保留。请检查入口能否打开、按钮和布局、触屏／鼠标编辑、预览、保存重开及助手操作。部分高级 PCB 编辑和仿真能力仍在完善；原生 USB 串口驱动未包含。本版用于内部及公开 TestFlight，正式 App Store 发布设置不变。
en-US: Focus on the schematic/PCB, LaTeX, biology and CAD-analysis workbenches in Space; PCB canvas editing, checks, schematic updates and change previews; LaTeX folding, PDF search and full-screen layout; music editing and presets; scientific tools, CSV and inline charts/content; iPhone navigation, task center and file batch actions; connection history and Bluetooth serial discovery; and Linux package sources, installation and preservation of existing runtimes. Check opening, controls/layout, touch/mouse editing, previews, saving/reopening and assistant actions. Some advanced PCB and simulation features remain in development; native USB serial drivers are not included. Internal and public TestFlight only; existing App Store release settings are unchanged.
